attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR) – Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of Division-approved CE sponsors (e.g. ASHA, AAA, ISHA and other approved sponsors under 68 IAC 1465.85(c)); college courses (15 h per semester hour, 10 h per quarter hour); postgraduate training programs; authoring papers/presentations (max 5 h each, first time only). 1 CE hour = 1 clock hour; half-hour increments allowed.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal of an Illinois license.
rules.audit_note: Licensees certify full compliance on the renewal application; the Division may request certificates in a random audit. Keep evidence of compliance.

topics.who: At least 1 clock hour of ethics training each 2-year cycle
Only SLPs who supervise SLP assistants: 2 clock hours in supervision each licensing cycle after the initial 6-hour supervision training (68 IAC 1465.35(c))
All individual licensees, every renewal (from the first renewal)

Health care professionals with CE (Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Practice Act listed); counts toward CE hours; from July 1, 2026 must include maternal-health content for those reporting maternal health services
Licensees with direct patient interaction with adults aged 26+; renewals on or after Jan 1, 2025, then once every 6 years (20 ILCS 2105/2105-365); counts toward CE
Renewals on or after Jan 1, 2025, then once every 6 years (20 ILCS 2105/2105-370); counts toward CE

rules.notes: Prerenewal period = 24 months before Oct 31 of each odd-numbered year. Holders of both SLP and audiology licenses need 20 hours for each license. Sexual harassment, implicit bias, dementia and cultural competency courses are IDFPR-wide requirements for health care professionals and can count toward the 20 hours (sexual harassment per IDFPR page).
rules.rule_quote: In order to renew a license, a speech-language pathology or audiology licensee will be required to complete 20 hours of continuing education in accordance with Section 1465.85.

rules.rule_quote: Beginning with the October 31, 2007 renewal, in order to renew a speech-language pathology assistant license, a licensee will be required to complete 10 hours of continuing education in accordance with Section1465.85.
